topic: Restoring surface conversion coatings, procedures and precautions.
syllabus_extract: Restoring surface conversion coatings, procedures and precautions.
specific_objectives: 6.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to perform rectification of corrosion.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of surface preparation and coating application on test panels; Safety precautions regarding PPE and ventilation; Instructor supervision of trainee application technique.
intro_questions: What are the primary causes of corrosion on aircraft surfaces?
Why is surface preparation critical before applying conversion coatings?
List three safety precautions required when handling chemical coatings.

topics: Inspection and assessment of corroded surfaces
Mechanical removal of loose corrosion products
Application of primer and conversion coating
development.content:
Inspection and assessment of corroded surfaces
Mechanical removal of loose corrosion products
Chemical cleaning and neutralization procedures
Surface drying and contamination checks
Application of primer and conversion coating

topics: Verification of coating thickness and adhesion
Corrective actions for pinholes and runs
development.content:
Practical application of rectification procedures
Verification of coating thickness and adhesion
Identification of common application defects
Corrective actions for pinholes and runs
Final inspection and quality sign-off

topics: Review of environmental constraints and storage
Transition to engine component corrosion treatment
development.content:
Review of environmental constraints and storage
Documentation of rectification work performed
Precautions for handling hazardous waste
Transition to engine component corrosion treatment
Summary of key procedural steps

summary_questions: Explain the difference between mechanical and chemical removal of corrosion.
Describe the correct sequence for applying a conversion coating to ensure adhesion.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the specific precautions required when restoring surface conversion coatings on engine components, referencing the procedures covered in this lesson and the upcoming lesson on engine component corrosion treatment.
